The image depicts Japanese lamellar armor (O-yoroi), which is structurally distinct from the target class 'breastplate' (a monolithic Western plate). Consequently, checkpoints requiring a 'single curved metal plate', 'raised center ridge', and 'smooth highly polished surface' are correctly marked as false. The Router did not skip any testable checkpoints and correctly identified that while some functional components (shoulder straps) and materials (metal/ornamentation) are present, the core geometric definition of the class is missing.

The texture uniformity is noted but less severe given the repetitive nature of real armor scales.

Score is low due to fundamental class misalignment, but not zero as it is still clearly 'armor'.
